name: PredictLeads
description:
Give your AI assistant structured intelligence on millions of companies worldwide. Data sourced directly from company websites, career pages, news outlets, SEC filings, and review sites. Continuously refreshed, with 5+ years of history.

Every API endpoint is a native tool: ask natural-language questions, get structured answers.

- **Enrich** known companies by domain name: news, job postings, technographics, key customers, lookalikes.
- **Discover** net new companies by criteria: technologies used, hiring activity, funding received and more. Filtered by location, size, and industry.

**Signal types:** News Events (launches, partnerships, leadership changes…), Job Openings (with salaries, seniority, locations), Technology Detections, Financing Events, Similar Companies, SEC Filings (as Markdown), Product offerings, Key Customers, and GitHub Activity.

Built for GTM teams, researchers, and investors running agentic workflows that need live, structured company data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PredictLeads to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PredictLeads to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.predictleads.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PredictLeads MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PredictLeads lists 31 MCP tools, including api_subscription, companies, company, company_connections, company_financing_events, company_github_repositories, company_job_openings, company_products, company_sec_filings, company_similar_companies, company_technology_detections, and company_website_evolution.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PredictLeads?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to PredictLeads in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
PredictLeads requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PredictLeads is developed by PredictLeads. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
